attributes.name: Headband of the Wolf
attributes.powers:
At the start of your turn, reveal this card to recharge the spell Aspect of the Wolf from your discard pile. 

Recharge this card to examine the top card of your location deck. 

Recharge this card to add 1d8 to your Perception check.
